name: B10-0424/2026 – § 3 – Am 128
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 3. Recalls that according to Article 10 of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union everyone has the right to freedom of thought, conscience and religion; notes that this right includes the freedom to change religion or belief and freedom, either alone or in community with others and in public or in private, and to manifest religion or belief, in worship, teaching, practice and observance;
